images.why: Source explicitly identifies this wild Sichuan takin as male; photographed in a Chinese nature reserve. Strong adult-subject option; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: 蒲春举 (Pu Chunju)
images.why: Photograph titled 舍我其谁 in a specifically identified Qinling golden-takin series. Relevant golden-form alternative; pixel dimensions and final crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Eddy Savage
images.why: Older wild Sichuan takin with substantial horns and shaggy coat against forest vegetation. Source confirms the reserve encounter; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Binbin Li
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies Budorcas taxicolor tibetana at Wanglang National Nature Reserve. Standing animal in snow provides strong coat/background contrast; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: 王勇 (Wang Yong)
images.why: Golden takins on a rocky ledge amid green forest and mist; captioned 雾中“金牛”. Atmospheric habitat option, although two animals complicate a tight crop; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Eddy Savage
images.why: Source identifies this wild Sichuan takin as the mother crossing ahead of her calf. Distinctive rocky-stream habitat; female rather than preferred male. Pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Jean-Marie Hullot
images.why: Photographer identifies takin at Tangjiahe Nature Reserve, China; openly licensed alternative. The requested _b derivative is below the preferred 2000-pixel size, and its download was not verified.

images.author: Katrina Liebich/USFWS
images.why: Officially identified Ovibos moschatus resting in autumn tundra at Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, Alaska. Confirmed 5184×3456 original; strong resolution, but resting rather than standing.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Caption identifies a muskox bull walking uphill; full-body subject with shaggy coat amid colourful autumn tundra near Nome, Alaska. Strong poster composition; dimensions unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Gallery explicitly labels the animal a muskox bull within its Greenland wilderness itinerary. Prominent horns and dense coat in tundra habitat; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Dr. Wayne Lynch
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies an adult bull photographed at −25°C; frost-covered fur gives strong Arctic character. Portrait-oriented alternative; this published file is only 1024 pixels long.

images.author: Steve Hillebrand/USFWS
images.why: Official Ovibos moschatus identification and wild Arctic National Wildlife Refuge provenance. Confirmed 2037×1432 original meets the preferred long-side resolution; photographed in Alaska.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Identified Greenland muskox, shown full-body grazing on green tundra with small flowers. Good geographic match and natural colour; shedding coat and lowered head are compromises. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Dr. Wayne Lynch
images.why: Caption specifically highlights an adult muskox’s long guard hairs, useful for emphasizing the characteristic shaggy silhouette. Canadian Arctic field-photography source; published file is only 1024 pixels long.

images.author: Marc Eggert
images.why: Photographer’s caption identifies muskox in Norway; standing animal on snowy terrain offers clean contrast. Freely licensed geographic fallback; 3000-pixel delivery requested, native dimensions unverified.
